descriptionLines: The peaceful Toronto Islands offer comfort to two best friends after a distressing hookup, in this moving exploration of trans visibility, identity, and intimacy.
In a hyper-capitalistic future, rookie EMT Joanna Broz finds herself in a struggle between job security and an Innocent boy's life.
A film to celebrate the 96th Saudi National Day
She has one night left. One apartment to empty. And one box she can't bring herself to open
Movie: Someone to Call My Lover
Rick is lonely, so he starts making phone calls to find someone.
events.summary: Someone to Call My Lover — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Joana Marques: Culpada ou Indecente

This one-episode documentary revisits the legal and media battle between comedian Joana Marques and the duo Anjos. Through archival footage and testimonials from public figures, it reflects on the limits of humor, freedom of expression, reputation, and the impact of social media. Where does humor end and individual rights begin? Could a joke destroy a career?
events.summary: Joana Marques: Culpada ou Indecente — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: M.I.S.S.I.O.N. 歌劇な潜入捜査官
events.summary: M.I.S.S.I.O.N. 歌劇な潜入捜査官 — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Accueil du grand âge, la méthode Montessori
events.summary: Accueil du grand âge, la méthode Montessori — In Theatres

descriptionLines: The film follows four voters from the same polling station in Rio de Janeiro between 2002 and 2022. Over the course of 20 years and three Lula elections, time transforms their convictions, affections, choices, and the very way they view the world.

Embedding directly within five active warzones, this urgent hybrid documentary blends raw frontline footage with stunning 2D animation to follow the humanitarian heroes risking everything for strangers. Transforming the testimonies of 100 refugees and aid workers into a global call to action, the film operates as a 100% non-profit rescue mission engineered to secure vital aid for half a million people a year before time runs out.
Movie: Mushroom Cloud: A Hibakusha Story

The documentary portrays the aftermath of atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. Through the voices of Hibakusha—atomic bomb survivors—the film transforms history into memories of devastation, trauma, and survival. Hidankyo officers: Michiko Kodama, Terumi Tanaka, Jiro Hamasumi, and Toshiko Hamanaka reveal enduring physical and emotional scars, as well as discrimination. They describe the political and international obstacles that shaped efforts to support atomic bomb victims and abolish nuclear weapons. The narrative explores the pivotal 1954 Bikini Atoll Incident, which broke the silence and led to Hidankyo’s founding in 1956, with members attending UN conferences to advocate for peace. Professor Peter Kuznick discusses how Eisenhower and many military leaders considered the bombings unnecessary, as Japan had already surrendered. He provides context on nuclear diplomacy, failure of the NPT and persistence of nine nuclear powers.
events.summary: Mushroom Cloud: A Hibakusha Story — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Ganj, The Treasures of Shah Jo Risalo

GANJ: The Treasures of Shah Jo Risalo explores the timeless wisdom of Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai a Sufi poet, saint and philosopher. Through the lens of his poetic works referred to as the Shah Jo Risalo, the film retells the harrowing tales of Bhittai’s Seven Queens: Marvi, Moomal, Sohni, Leela, Noori, Sassi, and Sorath. Written nearly 350 years ago, these stories remarkably challenge patriarchal notions by portraying women as self determined, and devoted seekers of justice. Featuring analysis from renowned experts and poetry sung by the legendary Abida Parveen, GANJ seeks to globalise Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai’s legacy and firmly establish him as the first known feminist Sufi poet in the world. The title GANJ, meaning bountiful or plenty, aptly suggests that the wisdom found in Shah Jo Risalo are treasures waiting to be uncovered and the messages of courage, spirituality and love remain profoundly relevant today.
events.summary: Ganj, The Treasures of Shah Jo Risalo — In Theatres

descriptionLines: In the 1970s, Tyn Bator left Hohhot for the remote steppes of Inner Mongolia. He revived a failing milk powder factory and received a promotion. After many educated young people returned to the cities, he married a local woman and stayed. When local herders questioned the effectiveness of rotational grazing, he took over the worst pasture. Within a year, he achieved tremendous progress, helping to spread scientific livestock farming methods. He put down roots in the steppes and devoted himself wholeheartedly to serving the local population.
events.summary: Son of The Steppe — In Theatres

descriptionLines: After her mother's death, Masha and her father, a priest, move to Lake Brosno, shrouded in the legend of an ancient lizard. There, she meets scientist Nikolai and his father, Igor, obsessed with finding the mythical lizard. Nikolai's experiment with infrasound sonar spirals out of control, killing Igor and Masha, who was trying to save her lover. Having lost Masha, Nikolai discovers faith—will he be able to resist death?
events.summary: Mysteries of Lake Brosno — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Early one morning, Mehmet Ali and his son Yakup set out on foot through the countryside. Although Yakup doesn't quite know where they're going or why, he tries to keep up with his father and literally follows in his footsteps. Mehmet Ali himself is rushing toward his goal, striving to achieve a result that is vital to him. However, the people they meet along the way and the events that unfold gradually lead them astray from their intended path.
A theater actress who masterfully performs roles on stage receives an offer to play the leading role in real life.
Twelve-year-old Anara finds herself under the watchful eye of her elderly physical education teacher. Her friends find out and decide to punish him.
On the eve of an important casting, actor Mark goes out for a smoke and encounters the White Rabbit. He embarks on a surreal journey that radically changes his outlook on life.
events.summary: Chasing The White Rabbit — In Theatres

descriptionLines: A pet store clerk and a customer argue over the return of fish, confronting themes of responsibility, pain, and loneliness, leading to a heated argument.

June 21, 1941. Chisinau, Moldavian SSR. At a military airfield, Captain Afanasy Karmanov speaks with a technician who asks if war will start: he doesn't know what to write to his wife. Karmanov reassures his comrade—no one wants war, but they are prepared. At dawn the next day, war becomes a reality. Karmanov enters the battle and shoots down enemy aircraft. "Karmanov" is a film about the final hours of peace and a man who doesn't yet know that in two days he will die in the skies he defended.

A mother who has lost her son retreats from reality and begins to hide in her own memories, where the boundaries between past and present blur, threatening to cut her off from the living world forever.
Jeremy, a spirit with no clear identity, struggles to secure his portion on the day of the spirits' banquet.
After learning that her daughter had frozen her eggs, her mother decided to urgently find a father for her "grandchildren" – and no obstacles would stop her on this path.

UNDERGIRL is a new feature film created by Jun Takahashi and his label UNDERCOVER PRODUCTION, expanding on the brand's 2011 "UNDERMAN" fictional superhero mythology. The film follows Yuri Ibuki, the daughter of the hero UNDERMAN, who must step into her destiny and become UNDERGIRL after her father mysteriously disappears.
Every year, five friends disappear for one night to perform a mysterious ritual—no place for outsiders. But this time, the secret can't be kept...
Movie: My Grandmother Puts On Lipstick

She sees spies in every passerby, and a dangerous drug dealer in her neighbor. He's burying his only friend. She has dementia, he has a broken heart. They met at a bus stop, and in one day they gave each other meaning, tenderness, and the desire to live on. Ahead of them lies a carefree retirement, but their grandchildren have already raised the alarm. This story is about how love transcends all ages and diagnoses.
events.summary: My Grandmother Puts On Lipstick — In Theatres

descriptionLines: After his onstage fall, the father continues to focus on rehearsals and raises his daughter through discipline and paternal love. At the community center, he pushes the girl through the same routine over and over until she's exhausted: she breaks down, cries, and runs away, but the father finds his gentle side, brings her back to her work, and provides support.

Pavel works as a music teacher in a small provincial town. The death of his younger brother in a war zone dramatically changes his life and forces him to face a difficult moral choice. The cause lies in a depressing family secret that only he now knows.

On the day of the funeral, while relatives argue over the failed wake and a wedding thunders beyond the neighbor's fence, thirteen-year-old Vasilisa tries to find within herself a sense of loss that seems to be felt by everyone around her except her.
events.summary: The First Space Rocket — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Director: Seth Domanski, Jonah Krugman Howard
A nuclear strike on Mars leads to a war-torn America with a rogue dictator and a synthetic kaiju at the forefront.

Fifty-year-old director Andrei pitches his dream story to the general director of the ITD television channel. Gennady Arkadyevich quickly tires of the director's philosophical outburst and wants to cut the meeting short, but then Andrei rashly expresses his thoughts on the production system. Creative producer Pavel finds a solution: he suggests replacing the leads with Yegor Creed and Valya Karnaval and calculates the project's commercial appeal using his fingers.

A young veteran, along with his mother and younger sister, is trying to build a new life in a new apartment, but the trauma they experienced turns their home into a place of tension and pain. While the family learns to live with the changed Grisha, the music and dance that once united them remain the only way to maintain closeness, love, and faith amid the trauma that thousands live with.

"We spend our entire lives apart, like the stars Shen and Shang." Orion and Antares rise and set separately, providing the film's central metaphor for lovers separated by space, memory, and fate. After the artificial intelligence-created Blue Snow devastates Earth, pilots He Xi and Yu Lan carry humanity's last hope to separate planets. Twenty years later, He Xi finds Yu Lan on the planet Shang, but their reunion begins to crumble, forcing him to protect both their love and the future of humanity.

From a young age, Katya helped her parents care for the cattle. One day, a cow began to speak to her in a human voice, and a friendship developed between them. When Katya learned that her father was planning to slaughter the cow, she decided to help her escape.

A story about childhood trauma, memory, and the ability to break the cycle of violence. A child performs a shadow play, telling the story of how his parents met. The tale is interrupted by an argument: the enraged father bursts into the room and destroys the play. Years later, the protagonist becomes a father himself and discovers the old figurines. Together with his son, he continues the story that was once interrupted. "Shadows of Childhood" is a film about a choice: to pass on to the next generation the pain experienced or the love that was once lacking.
Movie: Légitime Défense - L'affaire de la route toxique
events.summary: Légitime Défense - L'affaire de la route toxique — In Theatres

descriptionLines: A family biopic. Set in the post-war years. In the Siberian hinterland. Frontline soldier Fyodor Fyodorovich brings home a trophy notebook he captured during the war, but his son Mitka, without asking permission, takes it to school. Faced with the consequences of his actions, he must prove to his father that he understands the value of trust and personal responsibility.

Driven by her grandmother's illness and a lack of funds, 17-year-old student Rosa is forced to abandon her school uniform for a dark path dictated by WhatsApp messages. In a world where the future is devoured to maintain the present, her identity is reduced to a single, repetitive sentence: "Come."
In a world where everyone is forced to listen to news and ads, a broadcaster breaks the broadcast with white noise. For the first time, the city falls silent.
Movie: Ася выходит из зоны комфорта
An agoraphobic young accountant is trying to choose between the perfect guy in her apartment or the imperfect guy next door, the only problem is the perfect guy in her apartment is imaginary.
events.summary: Ася выходит из зоны комфорта — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: La Classe, les plus grands sketchs
events.summary: La Classe, les plus grands sketchs — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Château Gaillard : le pari fou de Richard Coeur de Lion
events.summary: Château Gaillard : le pari fou de Richard Coeur de Lion — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Two detectives searching for a woman who was described as despaired, but they don't believe it, since it all happened in a weird city.

Keinaan does what some Finns have long wished he would: he goes back to where he came from, even though he has never actually been there. Accompanied by his cinematographer Hamsa, Keinaan travels to Somalia, the homeland of their parents.
events.summary: Keinaan, mee takas Somaliaan — In Theatres

descriptionLines: This 45-minute reimagining brings modern animation and fresh storytelling to the classic tale. In this new adventure, Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.
events.summary: Barbie in the Nutcracker — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Prominent Black and Jewish figures engage in conversations about rifts in their historic alliance, partly centered on but not limited to current events in the Middle East.

Ata and Damla, two university seniors on their final exam day, have to make it from one side of Istanbul to the other in time to deliver their final exam papers. Little do they realize that this final task is also their last task as two university students in their 20's.
Movie: Till The Milk Runs Dry
A young Bharatanatyam dancer at a prestigious academy faces mounting pressure to end an unexpected pregnancy or risk losing the only life she’s ever known.
events.summary: Till The Milk Runs Dry — In Theatres

descriptionLines: When a night of partying leads four friends to kick on, at the extravagant drug-fueled lair of a mobster's reckless son, they find themselves fighting for their lives amidst a brutal spiral of paranoia, violence and ultimate betrayal.

Blending archival footage, personal testimony and a decades-long search for answers, Melissa Saavedra Gil transforms a childhood tragedy into a powerful exploration of memory, truth, and healing. An intimate and deeply resonant debut that illuminates both a personal story and a generation shaped by violence.
Set against the systemic oppression of Chinese American communities, this elegant, spine-chilling drama follows two siblings in 1952 Utah as they search for their family's hidden treasure.
Movie: The Spectacular Death of Prisca
On her daughter’s wedding day, a mother finds herself catapulted into a fever-dream quest to rescue her daughter.
events.summary: The Spectacular Death of Prisca — In Theatres

descriptionLines: When a citywide blackout knocks out the power on one of the hottest days on record, a group of neighborhood kids set out in search of relief, unaware that the day will quietly mark the end of their childhood.
A transgender woman with Alzheimer's moves into a retirement home. As her lucidity wanes, she must confront the challenges of her condition and fight for her identity once more.
Movie: Steel: The Blood Of Us

Steel: The Blood of Us is a cinematic love letter to the end of the industrial revolution, capturing the community of Port Talbot, Wales, in the final years of traditional steelmaking. Through raw, poetic storytelling and evocatively shot on 16mm film it weaves together the voices of generations to celebrate a way of life on the brink of vanishing.
events.summary: Steel: The Blood Of Us — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Over a weekend of skiing, 14-year-old Aiden navigates the boundaries of his friendship with Lucas.
Movie: Zjili: A Story of Sisterhood and The Burdens of Excess
Director: Christine Boateng, Hajara Musah Chambas
The story draws from the experiences of several kayayei, who carry 55-kilogram bales of imported secondhand clothing around Kantamanto, Accra’s principal secondhand clothing market.
events.summary: Zjili: A Story of Sisterhood and The Burdens of Excess — In Theatres

descriptionLines: A former South Asian bodybuilder moves back in with his aging father to become his primary caregiver, forcing him to balance the physical strength that once defined him with the mental and emotional challenges of caring for the man who raised him.

A major tennis tournament is about to begin, and the tension is palpable. On the court, two ball girls crouch on either side of the net. Each believes her moment has arrived. They want to be the best ball girls in the tournament's history. The ultimate ball girl championship.  But when the match begins and the girls look into each other's eyes, they are surprised to discover another force beyond the net: attraction. A dynamic that begins as bitter rivalry transforms into a magnetic passion, during which the girls search for a way to escape the competition that stands in the way of their love.
Movie: Hadas pasan por mi casa
events.summary: Hadas pasan por mi casa — In Theatres

descriptionLines: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

After basketball practice, a 15-year-old girl meets a stranger for a transaction that goes almost as planned. Confronted with her own limits, she will come to harshly realize her place in the real world, beyond the court.
Movie: Madeon: There Is No Band

Ahead of a landmark performance at Red Rocks, we followed Madeon behind the scenes as he prepared to unveil an entirely new era of his career. From the earliest concepts and production of the show to rehearsals, visual effects, and the final preparations before taking the stage, this documentary gives an inside look at the creative process behind bringing his new vision to life.
events.summary: Madeon: There Is No Band — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
A documentary on Darlene Love, the singer and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee known for “He’s a Rebel” and collaborations with Cher, Bruce Springsteen, Dionne Warwick, Sam Cooke and other greats.
events.summary: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been — In Theatres

descriptionLines: When a ruthless terrorist threatens to detonate explosives across Mexico's most strategic military bases, a daring secret agent races against time to stop the attack. As the mission intensifies, he faces relentless enemies, brutal take-downs, and a heart-pounding skydiving sequence that takes the action to new heights.
When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

A man in a seemingly stable relationship hides a private world of fantasy that slowly takes over his life. When a third presence appears, he is forced to confront what his addiction has done to intimacy, love and his own sense of self.
In a dystopian future, a young couple clashes during their time-traveling vacation.
A young woman, Eliza, returns to her hometown for summer break, and must confront a fragment of her past.
Movie: God Bless You, Mr. Kopu

A struggling Tongan immigrant is taken under the wing of a charismatic American salesman. What begins as a dream job quickly unravels into a nightmare as the protégé begins questioning his mentor’s methods.
events.summary: God Bless You, Mr. Kopu — In Theatres

descriptionLines: In occupied Poland 1943, German official Martin Wolff is sent to a remote village to investigate the disappearance of a Jewish lawyer. His arrival unsettles the fragile order between scarred villagers, corrupt collaborators, and Nazi authorities, unearthing a web of betrayal and greed tied to whispers of the lawyer’s hidden fortune. Yet as the village’s darkest truths come to light, Wolff’s search may be hiding more than it reveals.

In a dystopian world marked by inequality and everyday violence, a grandmother is determined to make the most of the time she has left with her granddaughter. But as a series of events pushes them into increasing danger, love and fear begin to blur, forcing her to cross lines she never imagined.
events.summary: Love Is the Monster — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Set over the course of seventeen hours, the lives of three young, queer, Indigenous sex workers intersect through chance, relation, and the shared experience of familial and colonial displacement.
Soviet Union. 1950s. Winter. An escaped prisoner finds a house in the woods where food magically appears every night.
events.summary: Where The Table Was... — In Theatres

descriptionLines: A young surgeon accompanies a group of communists from the Chechen-Ingush Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic secretly carrying a letter to L.I. Brezhnev in 1972. The story, which changed the fate of a nation, is based on true events.

Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.
events.summary: Where the River Begins — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Laurel always imagined her first kiss would be a fairy tale. Instead, that fantasy turns frightening when she's cursed with an ability to see the death of anyone she kisses. After a vision reveals her crush is doomed to die in a strange murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to unmask the killer before the mystery becomes a massacre.

Inspired by true events in the 1920s Yucca Valley, a miner named Johnny Lang seals his cannibal son behind an iron door. Generations later, a motorcycle shop owner named Zach receives a journal, a letter, and a gold ring from his estranged father detailing the legend, leading him and his friends on a dangerous desert trip.

Thirty years ago, a little girl watched her parents’ wedding, remembering the lilies in her mother’s hands. Today, she is getting married herself in Dnipro, a Ukrainian city living through years of war and air raid sirens. Katya’s father was a liquidator of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster. He called himself and his friends “larks” — birds that are the first to rise into the spring sky — and called his struggle to survive after the catastrophe “Chernobyl-2.” In 2022, a new catastrophe enters the lives of his wife Tanya and daughter Katya: Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Combining archival footage filmed more than twenty years ago with material shot during the current war, Chernobyl-2: Life After traces how one catastrophe echoes through another — and how a family living in the shadow of Chernobyl and war continues to love, laugh, endure, and move forward.
Movie: El cas de l'avi pistoler
events.summary: El cas de l'avi pistoler — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Locker Room - Zwischen Sieg und Morgen
events.summary: Locker Room - Zwischen Sieg und Morgen — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Swallows, I'm Giving You The Green Light!

Elina and Sasha are a disabled couple building a home together and a relationship based on equality. Elina has lived with a disability since childhood, and Sasha ended up in a wheelchair after being wounded near Bakhmut. As he learns to live in his new reality, memories of the war keep bringing him back to the past.
events.summary: Swallows, I'm Giving You The Green Light! — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: Des feux extrêmes en France : sommes-nous prêts ?
events.summary: Des feux extrêmes en France : sommes-nous prêts ? — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Valentina knows all too well what it means to be responsible for those we have tamed. She runs the Time of Cats shelter while also working as a lawyer and raising two children. The shelter began as a cat café in the city center, where 250 cats found new homes over five years. But after a disagreement with the landlord, it had to move to the outskirts and become a shelter, making it less convenient for visitors. Today, Time of Cats is home to more than 90 cats, and despite the help of volunteers, the responsibility for them rests largely on Valentina. Finding funding and dealing with the cats’ daily needs take up much of her life. Now another problem has emerged: the owner plans to sell the building. Once again, the shelter must find a new home.
events.summary: The Time of Cats — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: The Mansi From The Village of Lopaevo

Vasily Viktorovich from the village of Lopaevo can trace his family lineage back 13 generations. Every one of his ancestors was recorded in official documents as a Vogul, the historical name for the people now known as the Mansi. Yet Novaya Lyalya District in Sverdlovsk Region, where the Lopaev family has lived and farmed for centuries, is not officially recognized as a traditional territory of Russia's Indigenous peoples of the North. How did this happen, and what will Vasily Viktorovich do about it?
events.summary: The Mansi From The Village of Lopaevo — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Director: Vladimir Ponomarev, Alexey Lagerev, Daniil Balushkin

In the mountains of the Eastern Sayan range, in the south-west of the Republic of Buryatia, lies the ulus of Myla. Life here is a constant struggle. From something as basic as heating one's home, the struggle extends to every aspect of life in this small Khamnigan settlement. How do Darkhan's creativity, inquisitive mind, and gifted hands help the entire ulus survive in the harsh conditions of Zakamna? And what philosophy allows Dondok Dorzhiyevich to reconcile the seemingly irreconcilable - being both a darkhan and a shaman who creates Buddhist ritual objects?
Movie: prague, with and without my grandmother
I was eleven, and instead of filming my grandmother, I filmed the spires of Prague.
events.summary: prague, with and without my grandmother — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Genre: Comedy, Fantasy, Music, Drama, Science Fiction
Hyper Misao is back at it again!
A pianist learns what it's like to really be INSIDE his piano...

Raised between dining rooms and take–out counters, the children of Halifax’s Chinese restaurateurs share stories of family, hard work and identity. Through intimate conversations and personal memories, Restaurant Kids celebrates a tight-knit community whose businesses became gathering places, livelihoods and second homes for a generation growing up between cultures.
When a young woman moves into a Brooklyn apartment, chaos ensues when she unexpectedly falls for her building's superintendent.

Media mogul, athlete, creator of the psychedelic superhero Captain Newfoundland, and an activist against his home province joining Confederation: Geoff Stirling was all these things and more. To do justice to a character as complex as this film’s protagonist, Mike Feehan turns the camera on himself and his co-director Jamie Miller as they weave together archival footage, animation, and fantastical recreations from Stirling's experimental 1970s late-night TV show, all very in keeping with NTV's original broadcast mission. Captain Newfoundland is an illuminating and wildly entertaining portrait of a complex man and his impact on the province that, according to Stirling, may or may not be the tip of the long-lost island of Atlantis.
Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.
Movie: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
Genre: Animation, Comedy, Family, Adventure, Horror

On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.
events.summary: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom — In Theatres

descriptionLines: A young soprano in the midst of his hormone replacement therapy must choose between preserving the voice that has long been part of who he is and fully embodying his identity as a man.
An actress prepping for a career defining audition starts to spiral as performance, identity, and reality begin to blur.
A douchey techbro gets more than he bargained for when the genderqueer demon he used AI to summon sloughs off his control and sows chaos instead.

Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.
A queer transmasc college student enters the campus Miss Intramurals pageant not to win, but to understand: is this who she is? Or is this the farewell to who she was?
A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.
Genre: Animation, Adventure, Fantasy, Comedy, Family

While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
events.summary: Heart of the Beast — In Theatres

descriptionLines: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest & awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that some powers exist beyond logic & he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.
A mute emissary with a mysterious past must transport a damaged soul to the netherworld before demons can claim it as one of their own.
Engaged couple Faye and Peter reunite with old friends one hot Southern night; however, when secrets are uncovered, the status quo of their "straight" relationship is thrown into question.

In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.
Movie: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
Director: Narit Yuvaboon, Thanadet Pradit, Chalit Krileadmongkon
Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.
events.summary: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Genre: Action, Crime, Drama, History, War
The struggles of the Senoi Praaq team, a secret unit under the Royal Malaysian Police (PDRM) made up of the Orang Asli community, specifically the Semai and Temiar tribes.
The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.
When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.
On an errand to the Hamptons, an artist’s assistant makes an embarrassing mistake that pressures him to face his creative stagnation.

A devoted butler inherits his late employer's mansion - but only until her cherished Afghan Greyhound dies. As he settles in with the dog, greedy relatives scheme to disrupt their peaceful arrangement.
A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.
Over the course of an app date, Matt tells the story of his "Fellas," and the scandal they get into when a problematic DVD box set goes missing at their housewarming.
The directorial debut live-action narrative short film from filmmaker Gustavo Obregón, better known as Gawx.

Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
events.summary: You Can See Everything — In Theatres

descriptionLines: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.
An irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.
The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue’s abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

In a remote village in the Pyrenees, Inés discovers that the relocation of an ancient church is only the beginning of an immersion into a magical and ancestral world that will change her perception of life and death.

A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.
Director: Eleanor Wilson, Alex Huston Fischer

On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

Reclusive government asset Henry Fitzgerald is living off the grid in Wyoming, designing new systems for a weapons research agency. When a multi trillion dollar investment management firm begins employing corrupt police and foreign mercenaries to force farmers off their ranches, the Green Beret veteran decides to employ his weapon prototypes to assist his neighbors.

Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
Movie: The Cat in the Hat
Genre: Animation, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Family

Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.
events.summary: The Cat in the Hat — In Theatres

descriptionLines: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

Tale of an elderly miser who embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.
Movie: How to Rob a Bank

A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
events.summary: How to Rob a Bank — In Theatres

descriptionLines: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.
Five Figurines is a Nigerian feature film directed by Akay Mason that will be released in cinemas nationwide on November 13, 2026.

Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.
Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.
Movie: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
events.summary: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.
Movie: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH

Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.
events.summary: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Movie: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争
events.summary: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争 — In Theatres

descriptionLines: No Choice is a short film about consequence, desperation, and the moments that push us beyond the point of turning back.

Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.
A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.
Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
Emperor Paul Atreides faces the fallout from his ascent to power as political plots and a galaxy-wide holy war endanger the future only he can see.

A small group of French high school students goes on a school trip to Pompeii to discover its ruins and the bodies petrified by Vesuvius in 79 CE. It is in this ghost town that they are suddenly overcome by a dizzying sensation. One after another, James, Toni, Suzanne, and their Latin teacher, Mme Mercier, allow themselves to be engulfed by desire, anger, and despair—until they surrender to it completely and lose everything.
Red faces his greatest challenge yet… surviving fatherhood while saving the world.
events.summary: The Angry Birds Movie 3 — In Theatres

descriptionLines: Described as a comedic drama set in the world of artificial intelligence, around the period at OpenAI in 2023 that saw CEO Sam Altman fired and rehired in a matter of days.
Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.
A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.
The true story of John Tuggle, who was given the title after being the last pick of the last round of the 1983 NFL draft.
